notes: The first name in the text, «أبو جعفر محمد بن علي بن الحسين بن موسى ابن بابويه القمي», is al-Saduq, the compiler; under owner ruling 1 the tool heads the chain and he is not written.
«عن أبيه محمد بن علي» and the following «أبيه / أخيه» forms are one link each, written as the name alone (rule 7).
Imams named after «عن» inside the chain are narrators, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2).
